description: This file defines a Flutter widget 'ContactScreen' that displays contact information for a restaurant, including address, phone, WhatsApp, and location sharing options. It utilizes provider for state management and interacts with geolocation services.

classes.name: ContactScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget that renders contact information page with options to get directions, call, WhatsApp, and share location.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget UI, displaying a scaffold with an app bar and a list of contact options.
